name: papc-core
description: PAPcSetup core that runs in every session (Claude Code and Cowork): one short rulebook, a navigation map to the right tool, cheap safety hooks (no --no-verify, no force-push to main, ask before loosening lint config), a context-size nudge to compact at phase boundaries, and a bounded, human-approved learning loop. Hooks are plain bash and never call a model. Harvested and simplified from affaan-m/ECC (MIT).
